hero.heading: Somewhere *slower.*
hero.intro: Sunrise yoga, long lunches and warm sea. Five unrushed days on the Mallorca coast with Vanessa and a small group.
hero.image_alt: Turquoise bay on the Mallorca coast

invitation.heading: Space to move, rest and feel like *yourself again.*
invitation.text:
Each day starts with yoga as the sun comes up over the bay. After that, the time is yours. Swim, read, nap, explore the old town or sit with a coffee and do nothing at all.

Nothing is compulsory. Everything is looked after.
invitation.for_you_heading: This retreat is for you if
for_you: You want a proper break, not a packed itinerary
You're coming alone and want an easy group to join
You've done a few classes, or none at all
You'd like someone else to do the planning for once

cards.heading: Two practices a day
cards.text: Energising morning flow and slow evening yin on the terrace.

cards.heading: A boat day to the coves
cards.text: Swim stops in water you can see the bottom of.

cards.heading: Long-table suppers
cards.text: Local, seasonal food made for passing round.

cards.heading: Afternoons free
cards.text: The pool, the beach, a book, a nap. Your call.

stories.label: Where you'll stay
stories.heading: A quiet villa above the bay.
stories.text: Whitewashed rooms, a shaded terrace for practice and a pool looking out to sea. The beach is a ten-minute walk down the hill. It feels like a home, not a hotel.

stories.label: The yoga
stories.heading: Yoga that works with your energy.
stories.text: Morning classes wake the body up with steady, spacious movement. Evenings are quieter: yin, breathwork and long rest. Vanessa adapts every class, so beginners and regulars practise side by side.

stories.label: The food
stories.heading: Food to look forward to.
stories.text: Colourful breakfasts, relaxed lunches and suppers that turn into long conversations. Dietary needs are collected when you book and planned for properly.

band.line: Five days by the sea, *with nowhere else to be.*

day.heading: Enough shape. Plenty of freedom.
day.intro: A typical day. Join what you like, skip what you don't.

timeline.activity: Tea, coffee and fruit on the terrace
Free time or the day's planned trip
Yin and breathwork as the sun drops

day.note: Exact times may shift with the weather and the group.

rooms.heading: Choose your room.
rooms.intro: Every price is per person and covers everything in the included list.

items.name: Shared twin
items.description: Two single beds, shared with one other guest. Come with a friend or we'll pair you up.

items.name: Double for two
items.description: A double bed for couples or close friends sharing.

items.name: Private room
items.description: Your own room and your own space.

host.heading: Hosted by *Vanessa.*
host.text:
The same warmth and down-to-earth teaching people know from the Clitheroe studio, with more time to enjoy it. Vanessa holds the shape of each day and gives everyone permission to choose what they need from it.

She'll be with the group for the whole retreat, from airport pickup to the last goodbye.
host.image_alt: Vanessa, founder of Vanessa Flow Yoga

travel.heading: Fly to Palma
travel.text: Direct flights from Manchester and Liverpool, about 2 hours 30. We'll share suggested flights once you book.

travel.heading: Transfers included
travel.text: Shared pickup from Palma airport at set times on arrival and departure day. Around an hour to the villa.

travel.heading: Arrive by 3pm
travel.text: Check-in from 3pm on Sunday, welcome circle at 6pm. Check-out 11am on Friday.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: Fill in the Save my spot form at the bottom of this page. Vanessa will get in touch personally to answer your questions, confirm your room and arrange your deposit.

faqs.question: Can I come on my own?
Do I need yoga experience?
faqs.answer: No. Vanessa teaches in layers, so complete beginners and regular students practise together comfortably.

faqs.question: Can you cater for dietary needs?
faqs.answer: Yes, with notice. Mention them in the form and Vanessa will plan for them.

enquiry.heading: Save your spot.
enquiry.intro: Send your details and Vanessa will be in touch personally. She'll talk you through the rooms, answer your questions and hold your place while you decide.

thank_you.heading: Your spot is saved. *That's with Vanessa.*
thank_you.message: Thank you for saying yes. Vanessa reads every one of these herself and will be in touch personally by email or phone.
